name: OPC UA
description: Browse the OPC UA address space of PLCs and servers, then read and write node values. Connects directly to the opc.tcp://host:port you enter (default 4840). Server certificates are verified by default; only enable 'trust any certificate' on an isolated network. Editing a watched value and pressing Enter (or moving focus) writes it immediately.

contributions.label: OPC UA
contributions.description: Connect to an OPC UA server such as a PLC or an industrial gateway.

fields.label: Trust any server certificate (insecure)
fields.description: Off by default. When on, the client accepts any server certificate without verifying its chain or hostname. Only enable this for an isolated, trusted network — with username/password auth a man-in-the-middle could impersonate the server and capture your credentials.

contributions.label: OPC UA browser
contributions.description: Browse the OPC UA address space, then read and write node values.
